shared_elements: rounded boss / disc-like protruding or circular element
curving incised lines forming an arc or band above the round element
weathered, monochrome stone surface with no pigment
justification: Both show shallow relief cut into rough grey-brown stone, and each has a rounded boss or disc set beneath a sweeping arc of incised lines, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a complete, symmetrical, frontal monolith with a legible head, banded torso and repeated motifs, while B is a fragmentary, eroded close-up whose forms are asymmetric and largely unreadable, so the resemblance may be an artefact of scale and weathering rather than shared design.
